name: lint_layout
description: Check a room (room_id) or a box (min, max; the 2 m cells it overlaps, a side on a face plane taking nothing beyond it; at most 4000) against the layout rules (1.4.3+), from what stands there now. 1.7.0+: the rules are data, the audit rules of lint-rules.json: the file the mod ships, with a lint-rules.json in the loaded save's folder (saves\<station>\) taking priority (a rule with the same id replaces the mod's, "enabled": false turns one off, level changes its level, new ids are added); both files are read again whenever they change. lint_rules lists the rules in effect, their fields and functions, validates a file, runs each rule's examples and explains a finding. Shipped rules and levels: not_replaceable (problem, reported first: a player could not place the thing again where it stands with its neighbours present, check_replaceable's rule on every piece, device and 2 m structure; the message names the rule and the game's reason), run_in_door_keepout (warning: a cable, pipe or chute piece in a door's keep-out), port_into_doorway (warning: a device port joins in a door's keep-out), port_cell_foreign_network (warning: a port's joining cell holds a piece of its kind that does not join it, so nothing can), floating_run (warning: a cable, pipe or chute piece in air, on no frame and no wall plane; in-line tanks and passive vents are not checked), run_crosses_window (warning), device_visual_overlap (warning: two devices whose mesh boxes run more than 0.1 m into each other, or one inside the other; things sharing a cell skipped), mounted_faces_out_of_room (warning), device_crosses_seam (warning: a mounted device's mesh box spans more than one 2 m wall section though it could fit one), controls_blocked (warning, info where the control side is the forward fallback: the side with its slots and buttons faces a device, frame body, wall or frame right in front), run_along_door (info), controls_not_on_wall (info), replaceable_unchecked (info), solar_outdoor_reinforced (problem: a solar panel storms reach that is not Reinforced), cable_grade_matches_network, controller_labels (a device a chip on its data network batches by name must carry that name), solar_unshaded, filter_output_capped (each filtration output network has a tank or regulator, and a chip writes its On), no_oxidiser_vented_outdoors (problem: an outdoor vent whose network or anything upstream holds O2, N2O or O3), fuel_oxidiser_mix_temperature, outdoor_liquid_insulated, deep_miner_column_clear, cable_on_frames (warnings). A rule that cannot be evaluated on a subject gives a rule_error finding (warning) naming the rule, the subject and why, and the rest still run; a rule that does not load is left out and listed in rule_source.errors. Returns region, cells, pieces, devices, structures, doors, counts {rule id: n}, findings [{code (the rule id, or rule_error), level, message, reference_id, other_id (the door, the other device, the foreign piece), at, subject (what the rule looked at), rule_id (for a rule_error)}] problems first, then warnings, then info, rules in rule-file order (limit default 25 since 1.14.0, 100 before; max 500), total, has_more, rule_source {mod_file, save_file, rules, from_save, disabled, errors [{file, rule_id, field, line, column, position, message}]}, elapsed_ms. Read only. No gateway is needed.
